title: Date Pasta with Creamy Japanese Twist
description: A fusion of Japanese flavors with a creamy twist on traditional pasta. This sweet and savory dish is perfect for a quick dinner.

ingredients.name: pasta
ingredients.notes: any type of pasta works well

instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large pan, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add dates and cook for 2-3 minutes until caramelized.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil to the pan and stir to combine.
Return cooked pasta to the pan and toss with the date and soy sauce mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer pasta to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onions.
